tool_args.rationale: The gradient and lag signatures favor the siphon-memory ODE, but the five pilot endpoints do not adequately constrain its five parameters. The trajectory batch adds time-resolved observations that can distinguish memory relaxation from its coupling into the observed state.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons leave no redundancy to test whether the fitted memory timescale and coupling can predict fresh trajectories.
Neither model represents the observed transient lag or uses the initial state and memory.
It does not help distinguish the coupled dynamics.
